task.title: Status-reorder panel accepts drags only on dragover, the Blink accept-flag defect class
task.description: Found during PR #105's review (the lost-drop bug, non-blocking note 3). The vocabulary status-reorder drag on the /statuses page answers only dragover with preventDefault; Blink takes the accept flag from dragenter whenever the hit-test target CHANGES under the cursor, so any future change that moves content under a stationary drag cursor (autoscroll, live reflow) can silently swallow drops there, exactly as PR #105's column autoscroll did on the board. No live bug today — the status list is short and nothing churns it mid-drag — but the defect class is open wherever a drop surface lacks a dragenter acceptance. Fix direction: route the panel's (and any other drop surface's) acceptance through a single shared destination function answering both dragenter and dragover, per the dragDestination() pattern PR #105 established, with the parity table covering the discriminating targets.
